g.text: Down Home Creole · dry blending and packing plant · 6,000 lb/day

svg.text: 1. Rates from design/out/line-balance.json; weekly basis 30,000 lb, 5 days x 1 shift.
2. CCP-1 metal detection (MD-305); CCP-2 is NOT claimed for the sifter: it is a prerequisite program.
3. Every lot scanned at weighing; MES links ingredient lots -> batch -> blend bag -> unit lot code.
4. Wheat (station B) is opened only in Pack room B and on the Friday blender campaign.
5. Blend bags are released in MES only after CV <= 5% and micro results; unreleased bags cannot be scanned at BU-401/BU-502.
